correctness.rationale: Discrete Fourier diagonalization gives the exact (1,2,2,1)-multiplicity spectrum. Exact integer power-root brackets at the two rational endpoints uniformly enclose 2^p and 3^p for all real p in the interval. Signed rational Taylor bounds enclose all exponential terms at three rational t values and certify all twelve sector signs, including a unique negative eigenvalue at the middle t. Continuity of eigenvalues proves disconnectedness. Reproduced with the standalone standard-library verifier; no sampling extrapolation.

value.rationale: The explicit fixed natural C6 graph shows that verifying an exponential distance kernel is positive at one bandwidth gives no larger-bandwidth guarantee, even with strict positivity. This directly addresses finite-data admissible bandwidth sets considered in the 2016 open-problem article. A full closed interval of powers and a certified alternating-mode obstruction make it a robust structural counterexample. The value is the demonstrated failure of monotonicity, not unsupported graph minimality or a full spectral phase diagram.
